newsitem.title: USA: Nationwide Ins estimates storm claims at $80 mln.
newsitem.headline: Nationwide Ins estimates storm claims at $80 mln.

text.p: Nationwide Insurance said on Friday that preliminary estimates indicate that Hurricane Fran claims could cost it up to $80 million.
The company said Hurricane Fran will be the third costliest hurricane in Nationwide's 70-year history, exceeded only by Hurricane Hugo in 1989 and Andrew in 1992.

The company received more than 10,000 storm-related calls since midnight at its two primary claims service centers in Columbus and in Gainesville, Fla., with nearly 9,000 claims from North Carolina, the hardest-hit state.
Because of transportation and communications difficulties caused by the powerful storm, it's difficult for the company to assess damage, Nationwide Insurance said.
